links.outcome: LLM accuracy identifying CLABSI/CAUTI under ambiguous or varied prompt formats, repeated runs
links.effect: Both models accurately identified CLABSI and CAUTI in all scenarios with clear prompts; ambiguous prompts with Arabic numeral dates, abbreviations, and special characters caused occasional inaccuracies in repeated tests.
links.quote: Challenges appeared with ambiguous prompts including Arabic numeral dates, abbreviations, and special characters, causing occasional inaccuracies in repeated tests.

unlisted_practices: Using clear, specific prompt design to improve LLM reliability for infection surveillance case identification

screen.reason: Evaluated GPT-4 and Mixtral on NHSN training scenario vignettes for HAI surveillance accuracy with different prompt variations, but did not test an organizational deployment guardrail practice.
